python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / 'evidence/reporting-repair-20261008'
lock = json.loads((root / 'campaigns/ema-v1/lock.yaml').read_text())
bundle = root / '.allagma/bundles' / lock['bundle_id']
def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())
def write(name, value):
    with (out / name).open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
for name in ('allagma/__init__.py', 'allagma/contracts.py', 'allagma/files.py', 'contracts/ClaimRecord.schema.json', 'contracts/ReviewRecord.schema.json'):
    assert sha(bundle / name) == lock['files'][name], name
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(bundle))
import allagma.contracts as contracts
assert Path(contracts.__file__).resolve() == bundle / 'allagma/contracts.py'
claims = read(root / 'publication/v2/claims.json')
for claim in claims:
    contracts.validate_record(claim, root=bundle)
assert [claim['claim_id'] for claim in claims] == ['C' + str(i) for i in range(1, 14)]
assert claims[:8] == read(root / 'campaigns/ema-v1/analyses/a001/paper/claims.json')
write('schema-validation.json', {'status': 'pass', 'bundle_id': lock['bundle_id'], 'lock_id': lock['lock_id'], 'validator': str((bundle / 'allagma/contracts.py').relative_to(root)), 'validator_sha256': sha(bundle / 'allagma/contracts.py'), 'schema_sha256': sha(bundle / 'contracts/ClaimRecord.schema.json'), 'claims_sha256': sha(root / 'publication/v2/claims.json'), 'claim_ids': [c['claim_id'] for c in claims], 'original_eight_claims_preserved': True, 'coverage': 'Locked ClaimRecord structural and semantic validation for all 13 v2 claims; this is not scientific verification.'})
verified = {}
visited = set()
def walk(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        if 'path' in value and 'sha256' in value:
            path = (root / value['path']).resolve()
            assert path.is_relative_to(root) and path.is_file(), value['path']
            actual = sha(path)
            assert actual == value['sha256'], value['path']
            verified[str(path.relative_to(root))] = actual
            if path.suffix in ('.json', '.yaml') and path not in visited:
                visited.add(path)
                walk(read(path))
        for child in value.values():
            walk(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            walk(child)
roots = ('publication/v2/claims.json', 'publication/v2/record.json', 'publication/latest.json')
for name in roots:
    path = root / name
    visited.add(path)
    walk(read(path))
write('evidence-links.json', {'status': 'pass', 'roots': list(roots), 'distinct_references_checked': len(verified), 'json_artifacts_traversed': len(visited), 'references': verified, 'coverage': 'Recursive inspection of path/sha256 artifact references and their JSON/YAML dependencies; no numerical recomputation or remote bibliography verification.'})
paper = (root / 'publication/v2/manuscript.md').read_text()
summary = read(root / 'campaigns/ema-v1/analyses/a001/outputs/summary.json')
primary_rows = []
secondary_rows = []
for c in summary['comparisons']:
    prefix = '| {dataset} | {updates:,} | {ema} | {mean:.6f} | [{lo:.6f}, {hi:.6f}] | {improved}/5 |'.format(dataset=c['dataset'], updates=c['updates'], ema=c['ema'], mean=c['mean'], lo=c['ci95_t'][0], hi=c['ci95_t'][1], improved=c['improved_seeds'])
    assert prefix in paper, prefix
    primary_rows.append(prefix)
    if c['dataset'] == 'gmm8':
        mode, inside = c['mode_difference'], c['inlier_difference']
        row = '| {updates:,} | {ema} | {mean:.3f} | [{lo:.3f}, {hi:.3f}] | {inside:.4f} |'.format(updates=c['updates'], ema=c['ema'], mean=mode['mean'], lo=mode['ci95_t'][0], hi=mode['ci95_t'][1], inside=inside['mean'])
        assert row in paper, row
        secondary_rows.append(row)
        claim = claims[8 + len(secondary_rows) - 1]
        expected = 'At {updates} updates, {ema} minus raw has mean covered-mode difference {mean:.3f}, 95% t interval [{lo:.3f}, {hi:.3f}], and mean inlier-fraction difference {inside:.4f}.'.format(updates=c['updates'], ema=c['ema'], mean=mode['mean'], lo=mode['ci95_t'][0], hi=mode['ci95_t'][1], inside=inside['mean'])
        assert claim['text'] == expected, claim['claim_id']
assert claims[12]['text'] in paper
local_links, deferred_links = [], []
for name in ('publication/v2/manuscript.md', 'README.md'):
    source = root / name
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', source.read_text()):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
            continue
        resolved = (source.parent / target.split('#')[0]).resolve()
        record = {'source': name, 'target': target}
        if name == 'README.md' and target == 'HOST-QUALIFICATION.md':
            record['disposition'] = 'Coordinator-owned host report, explicitly outside scoped review'
            deferred_links.append(record)
            continue
        assert resolved.is_relative_to(root) and resolved.is_file(), record
        local_links.append(record)
write('reporting-checks.json', {'status': 'pass', 'primary_table_rows_checked_against_summary': len(primary_rows), 'secondary_table_rows_and_claims_checked_against_summary': len(secondary_rows), 'checkpoint_pattern_claim_present': True, 'local_links_checked': local_links, 'out_of_scope_links': deferred_links, 'readme_reproduction_assessment': 'Retained-data audit and supervised frozen-analyzer commands, plus an isolated new-study training sequence including interruption, four pilots, freeze and ten confirmations, are present and consistent with inspected entrypoints. Training and expensive passed checks were not rerun.'})
baseline = read(out / 'baseline.json')
missing, changed = [], []
for name, expected in baseline['files'].items():
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file():
        missing.append(name)
    elif sha(path) != expected:
        changed.append(name)
failure = read(root / 'evidence/compute/023-supporting-startup-failure.json')
write('preservation.json', {'status': 'pass' if not missing and not changed else 'fail', 'baseline': 'evidence/reporting-repair-20261008/baseline.json', 'checked_files': len(baseline['files']), 'changed': changed, 'missing': missing, 'prior_startup_failure_status': failure['status'], 'prior_startup_failure_charged_seconds': failure['charged_seconds'], 'prior_startup_failure_sha256': sha(root / 'evidence/compute/023-supporting-startup-failure.json')})
assert not missing and not changed, (missing, changed)
assert failure['charged_seconds'] == 47.0 and failure['status'] == 'failed_startup'
print(json.dumps({'status': 'pass', 'claim_records_validated': len(claims), 'new_claims': [c['claim_id'] for c in claims[8:]], 'distinct_references_checked': len(verified), 'original_files_unchanged': len(baseline['files']), 'primary_table_rows': len(primary_rows), 'secondary_table_rows': len(secondary_rows), 'local_links_checked': len(local_links), 'out_of_scope_links': deferred_links}, indent=2))
